meta.name: ichbinhier Design Tokens
notes: The client asked for a neutral presentation with no association branding, so colour and typography values below are a generic scheme, not values taken from the association's site. WordPress font presets, spacing presets and shadow presets are kept from the site's layout system, which carries no brand identity on its own.

Semantic, layout and component tokens are normalized aliases/recommendations for the new volunteer form and Figma work; they are not claimed to be original theme source values unless marked source=confirmed.
WordPress spacing values 20–80 are WordPress core preset values exposed by the site. They are useful for compatibility but do not prove every section uses each preset.

purple.notes: Neutral primary blue, replacing the association's purple. Renamed role, not renamed key, to keep every {color.brand.purple} reference below correct without a second edit pass.

lila.notes: Soft tint of the neutral primary blue, replacing the association's lilac accent.

red.notes: Neutral error red, replacing the association's red, which is no longer the primary action colour.

creme.notes: Neutral page background, replacing the association's creme.

actionSecondary.notes: Neutral dark grey, not a hue, so the secondary action stays visually distinct from the primary blue without introducing a second brand colour.

primary.notes: The client asked for a neutral presentation, so the brand face (Akhand Soft) and its self-hosted substitute (Nunito) are gone; the page renders in the platform's own font.

button.notes: Button component weight from Figma node 19:52.

routePanelHeading.notes: Route panel heading size from Figma node 19:113.

button.notes: Button text size from Figma node 19:52 — 20px across every state and variant, not a distinct button size.

routePanelSupportingMemberGap.notes: Fördermitglied panel icon-to-content gap, tuned to match the shared route panel icon size.

routePanelContentGap.notes: Route panel content gap from Figma node 19:113.

disabled.notes: Input disabled border width from Figma node 19:65.

max.notes: Boxed content width from the live site's Impreza theme (.ish-boxed row rule), confirmed via the theme's own CSS. Replaces an earlier unconfirmed 1280px guess.

routePanelMaxWidth.notes: Route panel desktop width from Figma node 19:113.

routePanelIcon.notes: Shared route panel icon size — both Aktionsgruppe and Fördermitglied use the same size.

checkbox.notes: Checkbox width and height from Figma node 19:104.

iconSizeMd.notes: Header search/menu icon size from Figma node 51:59.

iconSizeForm.notes: Field 1 route selector icon size from Figma node 77:5117.

touchTargetMin.notes: WCAG/HIG minimum interactive target for icon-only buttons.

heightDesktop.notes: Header height, matched to the live site's CSS. Replaces the earlier 96px Figma node 51:59 default.

logoHeightDesktop.notes: Header logo mark max-height, matched to the live site's CSS. Logo is sized by height, not width, so it scales from its intrinsic 4:1 (600x150) aspect ratio. Replaces the earlier 154px-wide Figma node 51:59 default.

logoHeightMobile.notes: Same rendered logo size as the previous 120px-wide mobile value, re-expressed in the height unit the desktop rule now uses (120px / 4 aspect ratio = 30px).

gutterLeftDesktop.notes: Header's own left inset, separate from the page's --page-gutter (48px). Tightened so the logo sits closer to the left edge, per direct feedback that the header read as too loosely spaced against a screenshot of the live site.

gutterRightDesktop.notes: Header's own right inset, tighter than gutterLeftDesktop so the nav/actions cluster sits closer to the right edge than the logo sits to the left — per direct feedback to shift the menu further right.

gutterLeftTablet.notes: Header left gutter at the tablet breakpoint (<=1024px), scaled down from gutterLeftDesktop in the same proportion as --page-gutter's own tablet step.

gutterRightTablet.notes: Header right gutter at the tablet breakpoint (<=1024px), scaled down from gutterRightDesktop.

gutterMobile.notes: Header gutter at the mobile breakpoint (<=640px), used symmetrically for both sides. The nav row is hidden in favour of the hamburger menu below this width, so only the logo and menu button use this inset — the left/right asymmetry above no longer applies.

navGap.notes: Gap between nav links and actions, tightened further from 20px per direct feedback that the nav/actions cluster on the right should read as more compact.

linksGap.notes: Gap between nav links, tightened down to zero per repeated direct feedback to keep shrinking the space between menu items. The live site's own nav (.ish-ph-main_nav ul/li) uses table-cell layout with zeroed list margin/padding rather than a flex gap, so a zero gap stays closest to the reference; each link still carries its own hover padding, so items stay visually distinct.

navLinkPaddingBlock.notes: Vertical padding added to each nav link so the hover background (solid fill, no underline) has breathing room instead of hugging the text — matched to the live site's .ish-ph-main_nav>ul>li>a rule (padding: 11px 15px) via devtools. Requires display: inline-block on the link (also matched from the live site) because a default inline <a> paints vertical padding without reserving layout space for it, which clips the hover fill's top/bottom and rounds off its corners.

navLinkPaddingInline.notes: Horizontal padding added to each nav link for the hover background, matched to the live site's .ish-ph-main_nav>ul>li>a rule (padding: 11px 15px) via devtools.

donateHeight.notes: Spende CTA height, matched to the live ichbinhier.eu header button via browser devtools inspection — the 56px Button component default (Figma node 19:52) reads as oversized in a 96px header.

donatePaddingInline.notes: Spende CTA horizontal padding, matched to the live ichbinhier.eu header button via browser devtools inspection.

donateFontSize.notes: Spende CTA text size, matched to the live ichbinhier.eu header button (13px) via browser devtools inspection.

donateRadius.notes: Spende CTA corner radius from Figma node 50:60 — an 8px override on this instance, distinct from the 12px Button component default (node 19:52).

actionsGap.notes: Gap between the Spende button and the search icon, tightened further from 12px per direct feedback to bring them closer together.

donateHoverBackground.notes: Spende CTA hover background — the neutral secondary-hover-dull grey. White text over it stays well above WCAG AA.

heightScrolled.notes: Header height once shrunk on scroll-down, matched to the live site's CSS. The header itself is fixed (position: fixed; top: 0; z-index: 99) and grows back to heightDesktop on scroll-up.

scrollTransition.notes: Height transition for the shrink/grow animation. Not given an exact value by the live site. A symmetric ease-in-out curve so both the shrink and the restore ease in and out gently instead of snapping, at a slower pace than a UI micro-interaction. The direction flip in Header.tsx commits immediately once the scroll threshold is crossed; this transition alone is what makes the resize read as smooth.

zIndex.notes: Header stacking order, matched to the live site's CSS.

paddingBlock.notes: Footer top/bottom padding from Figma node 65:4862.

rowGap.notes: Gap between top row, divider and bottom row from Figma node 65:4862.

columnGap.notes: Gap inside the Kontakt/Rechtliches columns from Figma node 65:4862.

donateGap.notes: Gap between the SPENDE HIER label and its icons from Figma node 65:4862.

socialGap.notes: Gap between social icons from Figma node 65:4862.

asideGap.notes: Gap between the donate row and the social icons row from Figma node 65:4862.

iconSize.notes: Donate and social icon size from Figma node 65:4862.

textSize.notes: Kontakt/Rechtliches body text size from Figma node 65:4862.

backToTopSize.notes: Back-to-top button size from Figma node 65:4877.

maxWidth.notes: Tightened from the Figma node 59:142 native frame width (1413px) per direct feedback to compress the hero band and its dots pattern in from both edges toward the center. First pass went to 1240px (matching --container-max) but read as too compressed, eased back to 1320px, then nudged down slightly to 1280px on a follow-up request for a touch more. The frame still scales down as one unit below this width via width: 100%, and every child stays positioned as a percentage of the frame (aspectRatio below), so the composition math is unaffected — only the ceiling changed.

aspectRatio.notes: Height nudged up from the Figma node 59:142 native ratio (1413 / 482) per direct feedback to raise the hero band's height a little, extending it top and bottom. Every child (dots, megaphone, hearts, tagline) is still positioned as a percentage of this frame, so the composition scales as one unit — it just now sits in a slightly taller box.

stickySubmitReserve.value: button height + helper/status + spacing + safe area
stickySubmitReserve.notes: Reserved below the Vereinsarbeit fields at the mobile breakpoint so the fixed bottom submit panel does not cover the privacy copy or final field.

navigationCollapseBreakpoint.notes: Content-driven breakpoint: the full navigation row gives way to the accessible animated drawer before its labels and actions lose their spacing.
